notes.title: Devblog #5 - Huge changes!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33525289/d0cb266b399e46dc79abe15b52fed9b752aac943.png[/img]

[b]Hello astronauts![/b]
Since my last post Rocky Planet has changed so much!

[u][b]Look what's new![/b][/u]


[h1]Dynamic lighting system with particles and steam/smoke![/h1]
[previewyoutube=36p9dR8NRsg;full][/previewyoutube]
I really want the game to be as much realistic as it is possible, that's why I am experimenting with particles, steam and bloom effect :) It is also visible during the day. But when it's darker it's... romantic?

[h1]Mining, Inventory & Crafting[/h1]
[previewyoutube=N49Oun1ixyU;full][/previewyoutube]
In the last week, I have also been working on Mining, Inventory & Crafting. 

[b]Mining[/b] - Currently in the game, the only tool is [b]the fist[/b], that can chop wood and breaks rocks! Don't worry... I am working on some other tools right now to keep your hands in the good condition :)

[b]Inventory[/b] - It's minimalistic and very easy to understand and use.
The player is able to collect, split, drop items just by dragging & dropping the icon of the item.

[b]Crafting [/b] - It recognizes selected Crafting Recipe and show the player if he has needed resources (by changing a color of its name to green)
or informs when a player doesn't have some resources (by changing a color of its name to red).


[h1]Optimization[/h1]
[previewyoutube=aGYBlWe79EU;full][/previewyoutube]
There is one thing that cannot be forgotten... optimization!
If you think the game may lags because it's "procedurally generated, with the infinite world", "It contains a lot of items" and... We can find millions of reasons why the game should lag...
But I have found one answer to show you... it doesn't lag.

The rocks will NOT be spawning wooden planks...
You will have to chop-chop the trees! :)

notes.title: Devblog #4 - The Astronaut walks!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33525289/f0a3491c197da72547b777dafdf65ec2b72fca5a.png[/img]

Hello Astronauts!

[b]Now we can walk in Rocky Planet![/b]
The animations are simple, it's the low-poly world, but honestly... It's so smooth and looks kinda natural.
I also added Headbob. For those who don't understand that strange world, it's "the shaking head", when you walk you also balance your head and body. In the game, you have "Headbob". Some people love it, some people hate it, that's why I made it optional and everyone will be able to turn it off in settings.



[h1]Video[/h1]
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=znurSevOPMU&feature=youtu.be

notes.title: Devblog #3 - Biomes
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33525289/5a80568721081e8fe935b7721cbfc277bf399e4e.png[/img]

Hello Astronauts!

In this devblog, I would like to show you the "Biomes generator"!

The code recognizes what biome it is and decides what rocks, plants, mobs, and minerals should be spawned. Due to the fact I haven't created any new models of plants and rocks, I used the same plants, rocks for every biome.

Don't worry! I am working on it! You will see new rocks, plants, and even the trees soon!

[h1]Video[/h1]
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=EyHajw2NoCk&feature=youtu.be

notes.title: Devblog #2 - New lighting system, new sky, new views!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33525289/7a0958b16fbf70e4500789b3d6793af1acd7a536.png[/img]

Hello Astronauts!

As most of you know I was working on the new lighting system. Changing all of the settings I have to change the color of the sky too. Now it's the realistic color - blue.
Additionally, I have changed the code that manages the rocks and plants spawning system. Now it's more randomized.
